[CONTEXT]
Designer completed T434 with a refined 6-phase Project Creation Pipeline spec. User wants to implement it.

Key features from the spec:
- Type/Subtype as suggestion chips (not dropdowns)
- Warmup web search before first whitepaper draft
- Project Chat panel (40/60 split with whitepaper view)
- Star rating system with <4 star warning
- Pipeline state tracking (setup→draft→clarify→dispatch→delivered)
- Dependency checkpoint, cancel/rollback support
- Cost preview before dispatch

[FILES]
- reports/T434-project-creation-pipeline-spec_20260909_213034.md (full implementation spec)
- studio/core/projects.py (project state, pipeline)
- server_modules/routes.py (new endpoints)
- studio.js + studio-projects.js (Project Chat UI)
- studio.css (40/60 split layout, chips)

[CONSTRAINTS]
- Read the full spec from reports/ first
- UX first priority (chips, chat panel)
- Integrate with existing external project tooling (T427)
- Pipeline state must persist across sessions
- Server restart may be required for backend changes

[WHAT]
Implement the Project Creation Pipeline per T434 spec. Start with backend (project state, pipeline phases), then frontend (Project Chat UI, suggestion chips, star rating).

[WHAT] Research suggestion S008

[CONTEXT]
Title: Handle brief internet outages gracefully
Category: architecture
Content: Brief internet shutdowns may be causing Boss or agent CLIs to crash. Investigate connection resilience, retry logic, and graceful degradation when network drops momentarily.

[DELIVERABLE]
Investigate this suggestion:
1. Search for relevant best practices or prior art
2. Find evidence for or against this approach
3. Identify any technical considerations

Provide a brief research summary (3-5 key findings). Include sources if available.

IMPORTANT: After completing research, call add_discussion tool with suggestion_id="S008" to record your findings.

[CONTEXT]
Research (T436) found retry logic is only partial - Gemini retries rate limits but not network errors. Need LLM-agnostic retry solution that works across all backends.

Research findings:
- Gemini has partial retry (HTTP 429 only)
- Claude CLI has no network retry
- Task-level retry restarts entire task (expensive)
- Best practice: exponential backoff (2s→4s→8s) at HTTP layer

[FILES]
- backends/backends/base.py (base class - ideal location for shared retry logic)
- backends/backends/gemini.py (needs retry wrapper)
- backends/backends/ollama.py (needs retry wrapper)
- backends/backends/anthropic.py (needs retry wrapper)
- backends/backends/claude_cli.py (harder - subprocess stderr detection)

[CONSTRAINTS]
- MUST be LLM-agnostic - implement in base.py or as decorator/wrapper
- Retry for: URLError, ConnectionResetError, socket.timeout, ConnectionRefusedError
- Do NOT retry: auth errors (401/403), bad request (400), model not found
- Exponential backoff: 2s → 4s → 8s (3 attempts max)
- Claude CLI is subprocess - may need different approach (stderr pattern detection)

[WHAT]
Implement LLM-agnostic exponential backoff retry wrapper. Add to base.py as reusable decorator/method. Apply to all HTTP-based backends (gemini, ollama, anthropic). Handle Claude CLI separately if needed.

[CONTEXT]
Project Creation Pipeline UI is implemented (T435), but the Project Chat agent that generates whitepapers is not connected. User sees placeholder message: "Project Chat agent not yet implemented".

The pipeline spec (T434) defines:
- User submits project description
- AI returns whitepaper draft with libraries, dependencies, requirements
- Clarify loop with star rating (1-5) until user approves
- Then BOSS dispatches worktree phases

[FILES]
- studio.js (Project Chat panel - already has UI framework)
- studio/studio.py (need to handle project chat messages)
- server_modules/routes.py (need project chat API endpoint)
- reports/T434-project-creation-pipeline-spec_20260909_213034.md (full spec)

[CONSTRAINTS]
- Use existing Designer or dedicated agent for whitepaper generation
- Project Chat should be separate from Hub chat
- Messages tied to specific project (project_id)
- Star rating injected prompt per spec

[WHAT]
Implement Project Chat agent integration. Connect the Project Chat panel to a whitepaper drafting agent that can generate/refine whitepapers based on user input. Add API endpoint for project-specific chat.

[CONTEXT]
User is testing Project Chat and encountered error: "Error: 'Project Name'" when submitting project description. The Project Chat panel seems to have a validation issue - requiring project name field or similar.

User's project description: "Calculator Crush - click highlighted calculator buttons fast, lifebar drains faster over time, good button = +life, wrong = -life + reset equation, valid equations only, enter adds result to score, crush calculator when exceeding int32, babylon.js, difficulty modes"

[FILES]
- studio-projects.js (Project Chat send function, validation)
- server_modules/routes.py (project chat endpoint)
- studio/project_chat.py (whitepaper agent)

[CONSTRAINTS]
- Error mentions 'Project Name' - likely form validation issue
- User already has project description ready
- Should work without requiring separate project name field (derive from description)

[WHAT]
Fix the "Error: 'Project Name'" error in Project Chat. Debug the validation and ensure users can submit project descriptions without hitting this error.

[CONTEXT] BOSS receives full context stack (### RECENT, ## CONTEXT, ## TASK, memory pointers, role constraints) on every incremental prompt. This causes redundant context reloading and wasted tokens.

[CONSTRAINTS] 
- BOSS should receive full context only ONCE on initialization
- Incremental prompts should contain ONLY ### RECENT (new user message + last response)
- Must preserve ability to access memory/file tree when needed via MCP tools

[WHAT] Refactor BOSS prompt injection to separate initial context load from incremental updates. Investigate how prompts are currently assembled and optimize to reduce context duplication.

[CONSTRAINTS]
